verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a SaaS calendar product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no API reference, API explorer, or runnable examples, and the probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The auth-gated MCP endpoint and the help-center llms.txt are separate capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
